title: Noetherian finite-stage factorization
statement: Let Λ be a Noetherian commutative ring, X a Noetherian scheme, F a constructible Λ-module sheaf, ν : Y → X an integral morphism, M a finitely generated Λ-module, and φ : F → ν_* constantSheaf(M). Then φ factors through a finite morphism f : Z → X with the same constant module value.

proof.text: Use finite affine free presentations and preservation of filtered colimits by sections on affine etale objects to prove constructible sheaves finitely presentable. Present the integral morphism as a cofiltered limit of finite morphisms and apply the constant-module pushforward colimit theorem. Finite presentability factors the supplied map through one finite stage.

theorem exists_finite_lowerStar_factorization_noetherian
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [IsNoetherianRing Λ]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    [IsConstructibleSheaf F]
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (ν : Y ⟶ X) [IsIntegralHom ν]
    (M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) [Module.Finite Λ M]
    (φ : F ⟶ (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) ν).obj
      ((constantSheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M)) :
    ∃ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (f : Z ⟶ X), IsFinite f ∧
      ∃ (ψ : F ⟶ (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f).obj
        ((constantSheaf Z.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M))
        (κ : (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f).obj
          ((constantSheaf Z.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M) ⟶
          (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) ν).obj
            ((constantSheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M)),
        ψ ≫ κ = φ
